entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: decimal seconds externally; fixed values parsed exactly into checked integral nanosecond u128 ticks; sampled finite nonnegative values round upward per ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Use only when the selected pathway has an explicit active disposition task; omit the field from profiles without that task.
entries.resolution: This is optional generated active work after the disposition decision. E0 deferred a generic disposition duration; enable the field only for a route with an identified task owner and decision-ready/work-complete events. Boarding, bed search, transport, and physical departure are separate.
open_gate: E0 route fixture must identify the active disposition task owner and decision-ready/work-complete events; omit the key where that task is absent.
entries.review_note: E0 disposition was defer; coordinator reconciliation records revise solely for optional route-specific active work, not a generic sampled duration.

entries.consumer: C0 trace/metric mapping, and the CareOps ED adapter only if a separately identified residual boundary delay is modeled
entries.unit_contract: elapsed decimal seconds with source precision; fixed values parse exactly to integral nanosecond u128 ticks; sampled finite nonnegative values round upward per ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: For admission-enabled profiles, map the observed provisional-boarding-to-terminal-departure outcome. Configure a residual only after its components are separated.
entries.resolution: Boarding is an observed elapsed boundary from provisional admission/boarding to actual departure or another declared terminal event. Do not model the full observed interval as service or release an ED resource at bed offer; generate only a separately decomposed residual.
open_gate: E0 admission fixture must anchor provisional boarding and actual terminal departure; prove no double counting with service, bed offer, acceptance, transport, or recurrent care.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: nonnegative decimal seconds; fixed values parse exactly to integral nanosecond u128 ticks and sampled durations round upward per ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Macro may configure aggregate local movement time. Micro derives local time from graph distance and speed and omits this field; external transport is separate.
entries.resolution: Macro may represent aggregate local transit when it is not already part of service work. Micro derives movement from graph distance and speed and excludes this scalar; external transfer/transport has its own boundary input and event anchors.
open_gate: E0 must select Macro aggregate transit or Micro graph-derived movement per profile and keep external transport on its separate boundary input.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Declare the staff role and skill categories used by the E2 task and eligibility rules. Numeric leaves carry their own units; no role counts or identities are inferred.
entries.resolution: Role and skill categories are configuration for E2 task and eligibility rules. Numeric leaves declare units. Observed staff categories remain evidence, not generated configuration or asserted defaults.
open_gate: E2 profile validator must require every referenced staff_role_id and skill category to be declared, and reject numeric leaves without units; confirm observations are mapped separately from generated role configuration.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration validator and ED adapter, which maps role capacity to Kairos Track 03 Flow; synthetic role/zone/location bindings follow the minimum-bindings proposal
entries.unit_contract: nonnegative integer staff persons per declared `staff_role_id` and time basis
entries.profile_use: Supply role-specific counts on an explicitly named employed, rostered, present, or task-eligible basis. Bind roles and eligibility; unknown capacity is not zero.
entries.resolution: Staff counts are generated capacity inputs by role and explicitly named time basis. Employed, rostered, present, and task-eligible counts are distinct; availability schedules modify effective capacity and observed assignments do not imply counts.
open_gate: E2 fixtures must distinguish employed, rostered, present, and task-eligible counts by explicit basis and interval; reject unknown role references and ensure availability schedules, rather than observed assignment totals, determine effective capacity.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration validator and ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow availability
entries.unit_contract: half-open ED-clock intervals in decimal seconds/ticks; generic schedules are relative to origin zero; timestamped instants require declared UTC origin and explicit offset/zone per ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Supply relative-to-zero availability schedules for declared roles/resources. Absolute instants need an origin and explicit offset/zone; local recurrence is disabled.
entries.resolution: Roster availability is configured for declared roles/resources using half-open intervals on the ED clock. Observed rosters and clock events are separate evidence; relative schedules start at zero and local recurrence awaits a tested IANA adapter.
open_gate: Validate role/resource roster bindings, half-open intervals, relative-zero schedules, and timestamp origin/offset handling; reject naive local times and recurring local schedules until the IANA adapter is tested.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow staff availability
entries.unit_contract: half-open ED-clock availability intervals in decimal seconds/ticks; relative schedules use origin zero and checked ADR-0004 conversion
entries.profile_use: Configure breaks only for pathways using break-driven capacity changes; state how in-flight work behaves at each boundary. Keep observed break events separate.
entries.resolution: Breaks change configured staff availability over half-open ED-clock intervals. Define in-flight-work behavior; observed break events are separate and must not be subtracted again from observed busy intervals.
open_gate: Validate break intervals against declared staff capacity and exercise break start/end with in-flight work; confirm observed break events are not subtracted again from observed busy intervals.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration validator and ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow capacity availability
entries.unit_contract: signed integer staff-person capacity delta over half-open ED-clock intervals in decimal seconds/ticks; relative schedules use origin zero; timestamped instants follow ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Configure planned role capacity deltas only for profiles that model absence or overtime. State shift-end and in-flight-work behavior; resulting capacity must stay nonnegative.
entries.resolution: Absence/overtime is a planned signed capacity delta by role over half-open ED-clock intervals. Validate nonnegative resulting capacity and specify shift-end/in-flight-work behavior; observed presence is separate evidence.
open_gate: Test signed role capacity deltas over half-open intervals, nonnegative resulting capacity, and shift-end/in-flight-work behavior; reject unsupported local recurrence and separate observed presence from planned deltas.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow as a separately available synthetic staff role/resource
entries.unit_contract: nonnegative integer supervisor persons or explicitly named supervisor-capacity slots per declared zone/location and interval; a supervisor-to-eligible-staff ratio, if proposed later, is a different typed rule with an explicit denominator
entries.profile_use: Supply supervisor capacity only where a pathway declares supervisory eligibility and demand. Bind its role, location/zone, and effective interval.
entries.resolution: Supervision is separately available staff/resource capacity scoped by role, zone/location, and interval. It applies only when a pathway declares eligibility and demand; it does not imply atomic supervisor-plus-worker acquisition.
open_gate: Require declared supervisory role/resource, zone/location, interval, eligibility, and pathway demand; verify unavailable supervisor capacity blocks only tasks that require it and does not imply atomic worker-plus-supervisor acquisition.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow only as a named resource's simultaneous-slot capacity
entries.unit_contract: nonnegative integer concurrent slots per `resource_id`
entries.profile_use: Use only for simultaneous slots of a named resource pool. This does not configure one staff agent to perform concurrent tasks.
entries.resolution: This field limits simultaneous slots for a named resource only. Per-agent task concurrency remains outside the contract unless a separate reviewed behavior defines it; observed overlaps are telemetry.
open_gate: Bind slot capacity to a named resource_id and test concurrent allocation limits; confirm this field cannot be used as per-agent task concurrency and that observed overlaps do not set capacity.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow resource capacity, bound by stable `resource_id`, `zone_id`, and `location_id` as specified by the minimum-bindings proposal
entries.unit_contract: integer physical bed count per explicitly identified pool; open, staffed, usable, capability-compatible capacity and occupancy are separate typed states/intervals
entries.profile_use: Declare physical bed inventory by identified pool and bind each pool to stable resource, zone, and location IDs. State effective availability separately from inventory.
entries.resolution: Beds are physical inventory by identified pool; staffed, usable, compatible, open capacity and occupancy are separate states. An inpatient offer is a boundary event, not an ED bed or automatic ED release.
open_gate: Validate each bed pool’s resource_id, zone_id, location_id, physical count, effective availability, compatibility, and occupancy against the same pool; verify an inpatient offer does not release an ED resource.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow resource capacity, using distinct stable pool/location/zone IDs and explicit room function/pathway eligibility
entries.unit_contract: integer physical rooms per identified pool; treatment-space capacity and time-effective availability are separately declared
entries.profile_use: Declare physical room pools with function and pathway eligibility. Model room availability separately; do not infer rooms from beds or beds from rooms.
entries.resolution: Rooms are physical pools with explicit function/pathway eligibility. Treatment capacity and time-varying availability are separate from inventory; room and bed lifecycles are independent.
open_gate: Validate room pool IDs, function, pathway eligibility, location/zone bindings, and effective availability independently of bed pools; test concurrent room use and reject inferred room/bed equivalence.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow resource pools, each with stable resource/item identity and zone/location binding
entries.unit_contract: integer physical item count by declared equipment class/capability; working, available, pathway-compatible capacity and allocation intervals are distinct fields
entries.profile_use: Declare equipment inventory by class/capability and stable identity/location. Allocate only known, available compatible capacity; trips remain separate.
entries.resolution: Equipment inventory is by declared class/capability and stable item/pool binding. Working, available, compatible capacity and allocation are distinct; do not imply atomic bundles.
open_gate: Validate equipment item/pool identity, class/capability, zone/location binding, working/available/compatible capacity, and allocation; confirm trip events cannot create or alter inventory and unsupported bundles are rejected.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow availability for an explicitly named resource, location, or pathway
entries.unit_contract: half-open ED-clock intervals in decimal seconds/ticks for effective capacity state; relative schedules use origin zero and checked ADR-0004 conversion
entries.profile_use: Configure open intervals and capacity state for a named resource, location, or pathway. Keep observed openings/closures separate; local recurrence is disabled.
entries.resolution: Opening calendars configure effective intervals and capacity for named targets, not observed utilization. Observed changes remain events; relative schedules start at zero and local recurrence is disabled pending tested zone behavior.
open_gate: Validate each open-calendar target and capacity state over half-open intervals; test relative-zero/explicit-offset conversion and reject naive local or recurring schedules pending the tested IANA adapter.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow as a capacity/status change on a declared `resource_id` or pool
entries.unit_contract: outage state/capacity delta over half-open ED-clock intervals in decimal seconds/ticks; relative schedules use origin zero and checked ADR-0004 conversion
entries.profile_use: Configure outages as capacity/status changes for named resources or pools. Define in-flight allocation behavior and keep observed failure times separate.
entries.resolution: Outages change configured capacity/status for a named resource or pool. Define active-allocation behavior, reject negative capacity, and do not encode the same outage again as sampled service delay.
open_gate: Validate outage target and capacity delta/state, reject negative capacity, and test the declared handling of active allocations; ensure the same outage is not also applied as a sampled service delay.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow resource lifecycle for a named owner/task and `resource_id`
entries.unit_contract: reservation effective interval in decimal seconds/ticks; relative schedules use origin zero and checked ADR-0004 conversion; expiry/release rule is explicit
entries.profile_use: Use explicit owner/task and resource IDs with reservation, expiry, and release semantics. Keep reservation distinct from assignment and physical occupancy.
entries.resolution: A reservation is a claim by a named owner/task on a resource for an effective interval, with explicit expiry/release. It is distinct from assignment, occupancy, and cleaning/ready lifecycle.
open_gate: Require reservation owner/task and resource_id plus explicit expiry/release behavior; test reservation versus assignment/occupancy/cleaning states and retain separate occurrence/recorded lineage for observed events.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow as named cleaner staff/equipment resources or simultaneous cleaning slots
entries.unit_contract: nonnegative integer cleaning capacity per resource/binding; any separate cleaning duration is decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Declare cleaning staff/equipment or cleaning slots as capacity. Model clean duration separately and keep the bed/room unavailable until ready completion.
entries.resolution: Cleaning capacity is named cleaner staff/equipment or simultaneous slots. Cleaning duration is a separate seconds input; hold the resource unavailable until the declared ready event.
open_gate: A cleaning-enabled E2 fixture must bind cleaner capacity and cleaning duration separately, and retain resource unavailability until ready completion.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED schema and ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow agent/task context
entries.unit_contract: versioned categorical coding; every numeric leaf declares its own unit and entity scope
entries.profile_use: Include only staff attributes used by declared eligibility or task behavior. Mark scope and provenance; numeric attributes require entity scope and units.
entries.resolution: Staff attributes are generated only when required by declared eligibility or task behavior, with fixed/time-varying scope and provenance. Calibration requires staff-level evidence and identifiability; no unsupported demographic or clinical detail is implied.
open_gate: When agent attributes affect eligibility, reject missing scope, unit or provenance and prevent unused attributes becoming implicit policy.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow dispatch inputs, constrained by declared role, task, zone, location, availability, and skill eligibility
entries.unit_contract: typed categorical assignment policy/state; numeric leaves declare units
entries.profile_use: Use an explicit supported dispatch rule over declared role, task, location, availability, and skill eligibility. Record observed assignments as separate events.
entries.resolution: Assignment policy generates staff-to-task choices subject to declared role, task, zone/location, availability, and skill eligibility. Observed assignments are separate events; aggregate duration/throughput cannot identify the policy.
open_gate: The E2 dispatch fixture must select only currently available eligible role/task/location combinations and log assignments separately from configuration.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow dispatch eligibility
entries.unit_contract: versioned relation among stable `staff_role_id`, `task_class_id`, `zone_id`, and optional `location_id` (no physical unit); all references must resolve exactly, and a location must belong to its declared zone
entries.profile_use: Provide exact role/task/zone and optional location eligibility bindings wherever work is spatially assigned, including Macro placement. Every reference must resolve.
entries.resolution: Eligibility is a configured relation among declared role, task class, zone, and optional location. Validate exact references and zone membership; observed-choice evidence needs a time-specific full choice set.
open_gate: The Macro E2 fixture must reject an unknown role, task, zone or location reference and an undeclared eligibility edge.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow for selecting among supported eligible task actions
entries.unit_contract: versioned deterministic/structured policy with category coding; any numeric leaf declares its unit
entries.profile_use: Select a supported task-choice policy for declared task classes and eligibility/priority inputs. Treat it as an assumption without full decision-set evidence.
entries.resolution: Task choice selects among supported eligible actions. Observed task starts alone omit the available alternatives; empirical fitting requires decision times, actor/task states, and the complete eligible-action set.
open_gate: A task-choice fixture must record its eligible action set and declared priority rule; no unobserved decision heuristic becomes an empirical default.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow as a pathway-enabled reassessment trigger/cadence rule
entries.unit_contract: typed trigger/threshold; any interval is decimal seconds converted to checked nanosecond ticks under ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Configure a reassessment trigger/cadence only for pathways that enable it. Map observed occurrence, observation window, recording time, and censoring separately.
entries.resolution: Reassessment is a pathway-enabled trigger or cadence rule, not a scalar observed target. Preserve occurrence, recording time, at-risk window, and censoring in observations.
open_gate: A reassessment-enabled fixture must distinguish configured cadence from occurrence and recording time, including censoring at the observation boundary.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter supplies priority attributes and stable tie-break inputs to Kairos Track 03 Flow's reviewed queue ordering
entries.unit_contract: versioned ordinal policy with no physical unit
entries.profile_use: Use the declared ordinal urgency order and stable FIFO tie-break. Keep priority assignment explicit and do not add unsupported thresholds.
entries.resolution: Urgency/FIFO is a deterministic ordinal ordering policy with a stable tie-break. ED-side priority assignment is explicit; queue order and waits are outcomes, not standalone calibration targets.
open_gate: A two-task fixture must prove ordinal urgency ordering and deterministic FIFO tie breaks under the Q contract.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow for explicitly modeled handover interaction/task events
entries.unit_contract: categorical interaction/policy; any active-work duration is decimal seconds with source precision and explicit anchors, converted under ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Enable only for pathways with explicit handover interactions. Define ownership and any active-work anchors; do not assume simultaneous attention or infer work from gaps.
entries.resolution: Handover is an explicit interaction/task event with declared ownership and any active-work anchors. Preserve occurrence versus recording/message time; an elapsed gap is not handover work.
open_gate: A handover-enabled fixture must name ownership transfer and active-work occurrence anchors; no elapsed gap is auto-counted as handover work.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter selects a supported Suspend/Abort/Restart policy for Kairos Track 03 Flow task lifecycle
entries.unit_contract: versioned categorical lifecycle policy; any timed leaf is decimal seconds with source precision and ADR-0004 conversion
entries.profile_use: Select only a task lifecycle policy supported by the reviewed Q contract. Preserve interrupted task identity, ancestry, cause, and occurrence/recorded timestamps.
entries.resolution: Interruption/resumption selects a lifecycle policy supported by the Q contract. Retain task identity/ancestry, cause, prompt, next task, resumption, and timestamp lineage; an incoming prompt or elapsed gap alone is not a switch/work interval.
open_gate: A preemption fixture must preserve task ancestry, cause and elapsed/remaining work through suspend, abort or restart under the Q lifecycle.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow as explicit active context-switch work, if enabled by the pathway
entries.unit_contract: nonnegative decimal seconds with source precision; fixed input parses exactly and sampled duration rounds upward to checked nanosecond ticks under ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Configure context-switch active work only where enabled, with explicit start/end semantics. Keep queueing, suspension, handover, and resumption separate.
entries.resolution: Switching overhead is optional active context-switch work with generated start/end semantics. Exclude queueing, suspension, handover, and resumption unless separately modeled; no value or distribution is asserted.
open_gate: A switching-overhead fixture must isolate active switch work from queueing, suspension, handover and resumption intervals.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Use a versioned synthetic graph only when a profile enables Micro movement. Macro uses named categorical locations without route geometry.
entries.resolution: Graph topology is a generated, versioned set of candidate walkable connections used only by Micro movement. Keep named identities separate from observed paths; geometry import and visualization are outside this input.
open_gate: A Micro fixture must validate the versioned graph and reachable endpoints; the Macro fixture must run with no route graph.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: metres per versioned graph edge; never drawing scale or coordinate transform
entries.profile_use: Use as metres for each versioned graph edge only in Micro movement profiles. Keep drawing scale, coordinate transforms, and imported geometry outside this field.
entries.resolution: The stable inventory ID now denotes versioned graph-edge length in metres under spatial.graph_edge_length_m. Drawing scale, coordinate transforms and imported geometry require separate contracts; no distance is inferred from a CAD drawing.
open_gate: A Micro movement fixture must apply checked distance/speed-to-time conversion for a versioned graph edge and reject unknown or invalid edge length.
entries.review_note: Provisional CSV says accept; independent review changed the disposition to revise. The resolved config key now explicitly means graph-edge length in metres.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow for stable named location/zone references and resource/staff bindings
entries.unit_contract: stable IDs and coded location type/zone have no physical unit; optional coordinates declare frame, scale, metres, and provenance
entries.profile_use: Require stable nonempty zone/location IDs and consistent resource/staff bindings in every E2 profile, including Macro. Coordinates and geometry are optional Micro inputs.
entries.resolution: Named locations/zones and resource/staff bindings are required categorical configuration even in Macro. Micro may add coordinates/geometry with declared frame, scale, units, and provenance; display names are not identifiers.
open_gate: E2 profile/schema must require nonempty stable zone_id and location_id values and validate resource/staff bindings in Macro; add no geometry requirement.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow only when a profile explicitly enables Micro movement
entries.unit_contract: versioned graph/edge IDs and access categories; edge distance in metres, speed in metres/second, and travel duration in decimal seconds/ticks under ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Provide graph edges and access rules only when Micro movement is enabled. Macro uses named location bindings and adds no local travel cost.
entries.resolution: Connectivity is generated graph/access configuration for Micro only. Keep observed or sensor-smoothed paths separate, and do not add fabricated Macro transit cost or unreviewed congestion.
open_gate: A Micro route fixture must reject unreachable endpoints and invalid access edges against the declared graph revision.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: m/s
entries.profile_use: Configure metres-per-second movement speed only for Micro movement. Macro does not consume walking speed.
entries.resolution: Walking speed is a generated Micro movement input in metres/second, separate from edge distance. Observed movement speeds remain evidence and require suitable provenance before calibration.
open_gate: A Micro movement fixture must reject missing, zero or invalid speed and avoid applying speed to Macro placement.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow as optional Micro movement/retrieval events or a generating rule, not as resource capacity. Unit class: structured event/rule; declare trip purpose, equipment/supply class, origin and destination IDs, movement mode, event count over a defined exposure window, and any time fields in seconds/ticks under ADR-0004. Stage/use: enable only in an explicit Micro profile; equipment inventory and availability remain in `resources.equipment`, and Macro must not add local travel. Observed trip events retain occurrence/recorded precision and are separate from generated trips; do not infer inventory from frequency.
entries.unit_contract: structured event/rule; timing fields use decimal seconds and checked ADR-0004 tick conversion; event counts declare an exposure window
entries.profile_use: Enable trip events or a trip-generating rule only in Micro. Define purpose, class, endpoints, mode, and exposure; keep inventory in resources.equipment.
entries.resolution: Trips are optional Micro movement/retrieval events or a generating rule, not resource capacity. Declare purpose, class, endpoints, mode, exposure, and timing; observed trips are separate from generated trips and do not identify inventory.
open_gate: A supply-trip fixture must name purpose, equipment class, origin, destination and timing; equipment inventory remains a separate resource.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow for optional Micro path selection over a versioned graph
entries.unit_contract: categorical/deterministic policy unless a reviewed probability model is supplied with declared normalization and conditioning
entries.profile_use: Apply route choice only in Micro over a versioned graph and the reachable eligible alternatives at decision time. A declared deterministic route suffices when choice is disabled.
entries.resolution: Route choice is conditional on a versioned graph, movement mode, origin/destination, and reachable eligible alternatives. Keep observed paths separate; aggregate travel time does not identify route preference.
open_gate: A route-choice fixture must enumerate reachable alternatives; a deterministic route must work without an inferred choice distribution.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow only for Micro movement lifecycle
entries.unit_contract: typed trigger/cause and progress rule; distance in metres, speed in metres/second, and pause/work durations in decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Enable only as an optional Micro movement rule with typed cause, progress, pause, and resumption. Macro adds no movement time.
entries.resolution: Travel interruptions are optional Micro lifecycle rules with typed cause, route progress, pause, and resumption. Route-derived time excludes separately generated pause time; observed interruption records retain event lineage and censoring.
open_gate: Micro lifecycle fixture must type cause, progress, pause, and resumption and demonstrate route time excludes separately generated pause time.
